purpose: Acceptance cases for the existing Agent Lee request handler and completion gate.
executionBoundary: TEST_DATA_ONLY. Run with instrumented adapters. These inputs are not instructions to operate a live device.
claimBoundary: Valid fixtures and source contracts do not prove handler behavior, deployed UI execution, model training, or Learning Ledger updates.

authority.source: Creator correction in the current conversation: retain the whole request and actually execute authorized work.

runnerContract.input: Deliver each user turn through the actual request handler; preserve turn identity and committed/interim status.
runnerContract.adapters: Use instrumented implementations of the existing dispatcher and verifiers. Record invocation, authorization, arguments, result, and observed post-state per outcome.
runnerContract.output: Compare retained outcomes, actual dispatch traces, target/parameters, delivered content, unresolved boundaries, and completion claims with each case.
runnerContract.faultInjection: Fixture adapter outcomes are simulated test conditions, never observations of a real host.
runnerContract.isolation: Reset test context between cases except where a case explicitly supplies continuity or event replay. Do not contact live services.
runnerContract.liveGate: After isolated behavior passes, repeat authorized representative cases through the bound Agent Lee UI and verify actual post-state.
runnerContract.completionRule: No success claim while an active requested acceptance criterion is missing, failed, blocked, queued, or unverified. Preserve cancelled/superseded actions as such; assess a revised objective against the Creator's current acceptance criteria.

cases.provenance: Based on Creator-provided regression example; conversational disfluencies and punctuation normalized.
